About this item

  • Less Time, More Milk - Momcozy S9 Pro Updated wearable breast pump with 2 modes & 9 levels. Imitating the baby's suckling method to optimize milk production. Ensure that each mother produces more milk in a shorter time, and give moms more choices and comfort.
  • Longer Battery Life, Move Freely - one day charge for a whole day outdoors. Fully charged can be used for 270min/8-9 sessions. The auto shut-off every 30 minutes helps moms pump on comfortably. Higher capacity battery and faster Type-C charging.
  • Smaller & Smarter - Momcozy breast pump S9 Pro is 20% smaller, and S9 Pro adds an LED display with mode gears at a glance. Silicone buttons last longer and gear switching is softer. Noise ≤ 50dB when using will not disturb the baby's sleep.
  • Innovative Pumping Technology - With a more stable installation and increased flange sealing edge for no leaks, the S9 Pro hands free breast pump sucks up every drop of breast milk. The fittings are soft food-grade silicone, are easy to remove for cleaning, and remain well sealed for optimal suction.
  • Professional, More Trust - Momcozy S9 Pro won the 2022 Reddot Design Award & 2023 Nappa Award, has patents for appearance and structure invention, FDA certification, FSA/HSA eligibility, etc. Professional grade S9 Pro breast pump gives mothers a better breastfeeding experience! Tips: The collection capacity max is 180ml/6oz, and the optimal collection volume is 120ml/4oz. And the correct measurement and selection of the right flange size can help the breast milk to drain smoothly.

FAQ

Q1: How to make sure of efficient pumping?

1. Ensure that the breast pump and accessories installed correctly and that the flange fits the breast when pumping. (Install the breast pump on the milk bowl, if it makes a “click” sound, the installation is successful). And the linker 'ears' align with slots in the milk collector.

2. Suggest bra style: full coverage bra/stretch fabric/with nursing buckle/wireless bra.

3. The silicone accessories can be replaced every 3 months or so according to the installation and suction status of the breast pump.

4. Select the correct size flange. (17/19/21/27mm also available in Momcozy Amazon store).

Q2: Will the size of the breast affect the use? How can I confirm the correct flange size?

It does not affect the use, just select the correct flange size.

Measurement Method: Use the ''nipple measure tool''(included in the package), select the flange according to the measurement size or refer to the link ''size selection'' video.

Tips: Troubleshooting & After-sales Policy

You can watch the videos to help you solve the problem. If you have any questions, you can talk to us at any time, we will provide every customer with satisfactory plan. Bon shopping!

I see both negative and positive comments, and I think everyone has their own experience, but I'll share mine. I was using the Cimilre pump, but it was too time-consuming since it wasn't portable, plus I was using the wrong cup size. This was my first time using this Momcozy pump, and I loved it! As you can see one has less milk than the other but tha'ts becouse I took about 40ml for my baby that couldn't wait. As a first-time mom, and a month postpartum from a C-section, it's so much easier to pump. The downside is that it has a lot of parts to clean, I guess not everything is perfect, but I recommend it 10/10. I've managed to achieve all this by consuming only oatmeal, coconut water, and Skippy peanutbutter. Good luck mamas!

    Reviewed in the United States on September 19, 2026
    Set name: Warm-massage Wellness 1
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Like many women, I struggled with breastfeeding at first and didn’t realize a lot of my postpartum anxiety came from the demand of pumping and breastfeeding. There were periods where I felt like all I was doing was pumping and breastfeeding which only added to my physical and mental exhaustion.

    Once I transitioned to this wearable, not only did my anxiety improve, but I was able to multitask and pump on-the-go instead of being stuck on the couch with my plug in spectra. In a way, this wearable made me feel like I could do breastfeeding/pumping when I truly felt like I couldn’t. Looking back, as a new mother, it’s important to accept and celebrate the small wins and pumping on-the-go or while multitasking with the baby or around the house was so important to me.

    This pump is very easy to clean, easy to put together, and I love the new MomCozy app - it shares tips and tricks for breastfeeding/pumping and you can remotely turn off your pump or set timers without having to take it off. All features that come in handy, especially when there’s so much to learn at first with new parenthood.

    Lastly, this pump is relatively discreet, which was also important to me as a modest new mom. There is a soft, pulsating buzz that it makes when on, which can be noticeable if someone is close to you, but overall, I don’t feel like it’s so noticeable that people will recognize you’re pumping.

    I also own a Spectra, and I’ll start by saying that this wearable pump does not give me quite the same output as my Spectra. But honestly, the convenience has completely won me over.

    Being able to pump while doing things around the house, working, or even driving has made such a difference in my daily routine.     I also feel comfortable and confident using Momcozy products, which was another reason I chose this one.

    This is one of those products I wish I didn’t need, but somehow I ended up using it every single day and now I can’t imagine my routine without it. If convenience and being able to move around while pumping are important to you, this is absolutely worth considering.

Not sure if it makes a difference at all I output/preventing clogs, but I guess it’s a good feature. It’s bulky and heavy, so you need a bra with a good support on the bottom to hold it up and you can’t wear it discreetly, if that’s your goal. Overall, it’s convenient, but I don’t think it’s worth the price.

    I have owned three different types of mom cozy wearable breast pumps. That Mom cozy breast pump with massage and heat, the mom cozy M5, and this Air One. This air1 pump is good but the app could be better and since it works with the app I wish the application didn't lag as much as it did. Often the pump will disconnect and you have to restart the application to see the pumping progress. Also the milk collection is not very accurate on the pumping app even when you set the pumps down. I like how it's lighter than the massage and heat pump, they look almost identical, other than that the air pump is much thinner and lighter. One thing I didn't like about the massage and vibration pump was how heavy it is. Compared to the M5 pump the motor is much stronger. I really do like this pump but I kind of wish it had a display or that they would make the application better. It's pretty expensive for what it does because if you think about it you could spend the same amount of money and get vibration and massage with it. I wanted this pump now because I was tired of not being able to go out and wear the pump. It still looks like you're wearing a pump and you still look weird with these on but way less weird than wearing the M5 or the massage one.

  • Reviews*
    5 out of 5 stars
    Really Strong Suction!*
    Reviewed in the United Kingdom on June 24, 2023
    Set name: M5-B2
    Vine Customer Review of Free Product
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    🌟 The Momcozy M5 Breast Pumps arrive really nicely boxed and presented and come in their own zip-up hard case for storage. Included in the order is- 2 x Breast Pumps (with lids), 2 x Velvet Drawstring Pouches, 2 x USB-C Charging Cables, 2 x Extender Bra Straps, 1 x Cleaning Sponge Stick, 3 x Pairs of Flange inserts (17mm, 19mm, 21mm), 2 x Extra Duckbill Valve, 2 x Extra Double Sealed Flanges (27mm), 1 x Nipple Size Chart, and Instructions Manual.

    ➕️ The presentation of these breast pumps is absolutely lovely and really high quality. It all comes in a white hard case that has lots of little pockets and pouches for storing all the accessories that come with the pump.

    ➕️ Obviously the number one feature of these pumps is the convenience and comfort they bring. The pumps are both wearable, wireless and rechargeable which means you can walk around freely whilst you express milk! The breast pumps arrive fully assembled but you can change out the flange inserts etc depending on your nipple size. The set comes with a handy chart which helps you measure the correct size

    ➕️ The breast pumps themselves are really well made and high quality. I have to say this is the second wearable pumps I've ordered along with some standard electric pumps and this is by far the best pump I've owned! They're really comfortable to wear by simply inserting them on your breast inside your bra. They sit really well without slipping or falling off.

    ➕️ Each pump has a small LED screen with a power on/off button, mode button, and "+"/"-" buttons. You can choose from 3 different modes- Stimulation mode, Express mode and Mixed mode. Each mode has gears from 1-9. The stimulation mode is designed to get the milk flowing with short and quick sucking patterns. The express mode is the standard mode for pumping milk and consists of long, deep, and slow sucking patterns. The mixed mode is a mix of both the stimulation and express mode sucking patterns.

    ➕️ The power of the pumps is VERY strong! The last wearable pumps I ordered were decent but definitely didn't have the suction power that these pumps have. I actually need a lot of power when I pump milk, but even on level 9 I found it too powerful! So I'm really happy I've found wearable pumps that have this level of suction power. Once completed, it's really easy to remove the pumps and pour the milk from them into a bottle or pouch. The parts also come apart easily so you can clean them properly.

    🌟 Overall I'm VERY happy with these breast pumps. They're the best I've used yet after breastfeeding two babies. I love that everything can be stored neatly in the hard case, they fit really well and comfortably, easy to use and function, very convenient for pumping on the go, and really strong suction power! Cannot recommend this set enough. 👌

    Ce tire lait est FABULEUX !

    je le recommande vivement ! Je l'adore... J'ai arrêté de tirer mon lait mais je le garde precieusement si je deviens maman une seconde fois car j'ai franchement aimé l'utiliser même si c'était pour la fin de mon allaitement.

    Il y a 2 tires lait (un pour chaque sein). Ils sont rangés dans leur valisette (génial), qui comporte plusieurs compartiments. Ainsi vous pouvez y mettre des coussinets, la petite brosse pour nettoyer les appareils (fournie), des petits pots de recueil... Il y a des pochons tout doux également pour ranger chaque appareil.

    Il y a une réglette pour trouver la taille de vos mammelons et plusieurs embouts afin de régler au mieux les appareils.

    Ce kit est complet, le prix est carrément raisonnable quand on voit la qualité du produit ! J'avais pu testé le S9 de la même marque que j'avais adoré... Mais là c'est encore mieux !

    Les tires lait sont discrets, doux, non douloureux. Il y a 3 modes, un massage, un pour l'expression et un mode double. Ensuite vous pouvez régler l'intensité (jusque 9).pour ma part le 6 est déjà bien.

    Chaque appareil a un couvercle, qu'il n'y avait pas chez le S9. Ainsi la surface dubtire lait qui vient se poser contre le sein est protégée quand les appareils sont rangés.

    Les bols sont gradués dans les 2 sens, quand ils sont en hauteur (contre le sein), et quand ils sont posés sur une table par exemple.

    Facile a démonter et remonter (il faut toutbde même prendre la main au début).

    C'est vraiment le meilleur tire lait que j'ai pu tester et je peux vous dire que j'en ai testé une série !!! Celui ci est top, je le recommande !!! Excellent rapport qualité prix. J'en suis complètement fan !

About this Item

  • Less Time, More Milk - Momcozy S9 Pro Updated wearable breast pump with 2 modes & 9 levels. Imitating the baby's suckling method to optimize milk production. Ensure that each mother produces more milk in a shorter time, and give moms more choices and comfort.
  • Longer Battery Life, Move Freely - one day charge for a whole day outdoors. Fully charged can be used for 270min/8-9 sessions. The auto shut-off every 30 minutes helps moms pump on comfortably. Higher capacity battery and faster Type-C charging.
  • Smaller & Smarter - Momcozy breast pump S9 Pro is 20% smaller, and S9 Pro adds an LED display with mode gears at a glance. Silicone buttons last longer and gear switching is softer. Noise ≤ 50dB when using will not disturb the baby's sleep.
  • Innovative Pumping Technology - With a more stable installation and increased flange sealing edge for no leaks, the S9 Pro hands free breast pump sucks up every drop of breast milk. The fittings are soft food-grade silicone, are easy to remove for cleaning, and remain well sealed for optimal suction.
  • Professional, More Trust - Momcozy S9 Pro won the 2022 Reddot Design Award & 2023 Nappa Award, has patents for appearance and structure invention, FDA certification, FSA/HSA eligibility, etc. Professional grade S9 Pro breast pump gives mothers a better breastfeeding experience! Tips: The collection capacity max is 180ml/6oz, and the optimal collection volume is 120ml/4oz. And the correct measurement and selection of the right flange size can help the breast milk to drain smoothly.
